title: Hounslow Emergency Help Points
summary: Offline guide to emergency medical help points, urgent care, and local hazards in the London Borough of Hounslow.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, always dial 999 first (or 112). Call 105 for power cuts and 0800 111 999 for gas leaks.

1. 24-Hour Emergency Hospitals
- West Middlesex University Hospital (24/7 A&E): Twickenham Road, Isleworth, TW7 6AF. From Isleworth station: ~15 min walk east along St John's Road and Twickenham Road, or bus 117, 235, 237, or H37 to the main hospital entrance.
- St George's Hospital (Nearest Major Trauma Centre): Blackshaw Road, Tooting, SW17 0QT.
- Charing Cross Hospital (Nearest Major A&E / Trauma Support to East): Fulham Palace Road, Hammersmith, W6 8RF. Bus 190 or 267 from Chiswick.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres
- West Middlesex Urgent Treatment Centre: Twickenham Road, Isleworth, TW7 6AF. Co-located with the main A&E department on the hospital ground floor.
- Teddington Memorial Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre (Nearby): Hampton Road, Teddington, TW11 0JL.

3. Local Environmental Hazards
- River Thames (Tidal Reach): Flood zones along Chiswick Mall, Strand-on-the-Green (Kew Bridge), and Old Isleworth waterfront during spring tides and storm surges.
- River Brent and Grand Union Canal: Fluvial flood risk through Brentford Lock and Boston Manor.
- River Crane: Floodplain risks across Feltham, Cranford, and western boundaries.

4. Essential Supplies
- Large supermarkets and high-street chemists along Hounslow High Street, Chiswick High Road, and High Street Feltham supply bottled drinking water, batteries, and essential pharmaceutical supplies.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
